words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.ex: He abidingly supports his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不变地支持他的朋友。
words.en: In a manner that continues without change or end; enduringly.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
v. 瞪视；转动眼珠
n. 眼睛睁视
adj. 瞪眼的；转动眼珠的
words.ex: He goggled at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他瞪大眼睛看着那个魔术。
words.en: To look with wide open eyes, often because of surprise or amazement; A pair of glasses with side shields, for protecting the eyes from glare, dust, water, etc.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: He misunderstands the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了这些说明。
words.en: If you misunderstand someone or something, you do not understand them properly.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.ex: The teacher emphasise the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了作业的重要性。
words.en: To emphasise something means to indicate that it is particularly important or true, or to draw special attention to it.

words.tr:
adj. 阿拉伯的；阿拉伯人的；
n. 阿拉伯人；
words.ex: He ate arab food at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在餐厅吃了阿拉伯食物。
words.en: An Arab is a person whose native language is Arabic and who comes from or lives in the Arabic-speaking world.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.tr: adj. 建筑学的；建筑方面的；
words.ex: The book shows architectural drawings of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了古老建筑的建筑图纸。
words.en: Relating to the art and science of designing and constructing buildings.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: He made a playlist for his morning run.
words.ex_cn: 他为晨跑制作了一个播放列表。
words.en: A playlist is a list of songs or pieces of music chosen to be played on a particular occasion or by a particular person.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr: adv. 完全地；充分地；彻底地；
words.ex: He fully understands the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他完全理解这个问题。
words.en: Completely or entirely; to the fullest extent.

words.ex: He wears a protective helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴一顶保护性的头盔。
words.en: If something is protective, it is intended to protect someone or something from harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.ex: The company follows ethical practices in hiring.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在招聘中遵循伦理规范。
words.en: Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: She uses cosmetic cream to make her skin look better.
words.ex_cn: 她使用美容霜让皮肤看起来更好。
words.en: A cosmetic is a substance that you put on your face or body to improve its appearance.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: He specialises in repairing old clocks.
words.ex_cn: 他专用于修理老式钟表。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: adj. 病态的；心理不健康的
words.ex: He has a morbid fear of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他对黑暗有一种病态的恐惧。
words.en: If you describe a person or their interest in something as morbid, you mean that they are very interested in unpleasant things, especially death, and you think this is strange.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: The news was false.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻是虚假的。
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The factory will automate the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将自动化装配线。
words.en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: The two countries signed a pacific agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: A pacific person, country, or policy is peaceful and seeks to avoid conflict.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.tr: n. 合作者；合作社社员
words.ex: He is a cooperator in the group project.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个小组项目的合作者。
words.en: A cooperator is someone who works together with others towards a common goal.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He gave a concise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了简明的回答。
words.en: Something that is concise says everything that is necessary without using any unnecessary words.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.ex: He finished in the fourteenth position.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第十四名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number 14 in a series.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: He is a prospective student at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的预期学生。
words.en: Prospective is used to describe someone or something that is expected or likely to happen or be in the future.

words.ex: He is highly talented.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有才华。
words.en: to a high degree or level; very

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: The city is growing because of urbanisation.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市因为城市化而正在扩张。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: His deduction was based on the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的推论基于证据。
words.en: A deduction is a conclusion that you reach about something because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: The children laughed spontaneously when they saw the puppy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小狗时自发地笑了。
words.en: If something happens spontaneously, it happens without being planned or organized, or without any external influence.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: The teacher criticise the student for not doing homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师批评学生没有做作业。
words.en: If you criticise someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The company sells its products globally.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在全球范围内销售其产品。
words.en: In a way that relates to the whole world; worldwide.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: The organisational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.tr: n. 野外考察；实地调查；
words.ex: The students went on fieldwork to collect soil samples.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去野外考察以采集土壤样本。
words.en: Fieldwork refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: This box is useable for storing books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子可以用来放书。
words.en: Capable of being used; suitable for use.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: The renovation of the old house took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的革新花了三个月。
words.en: The act of improving by renewing and restoring.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He speaks English with great fluency.
words.ex_cn: 他英语说得很流利。
words.en: Fluency is the ability to speak or write a language easily and well.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: The city is progressively becoming more crowded.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在逐步变得更加拥挤。
words.en: In a way that happens or develops gradually or in stages; increasingly.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.ex: The country wants to industrialise to create more jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望工业化以创造更多就业机会。
words.en: To industrialise means to develop industry on a wide scale in a country or region.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机在红灯处停了车。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: They dine at 7 every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上七点进餐。
words.en: To dine means to eat dinner.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: He works on an agricultural farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个农场工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: He could not conceive a world without technology.
words.ex_cn: 他无法设想一个没有科技的世界。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; to become pregnant.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: She will organise a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将组织一次会议。
words.en: To organise means to arrange or plan something systematically, especially events or activities.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很大可能会下雨。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

words.ex: He lives in the southeastern part of the country.
words.ex_cn: 他住在国家的东南部。
words.en: located in or towards the southeast

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: The rain was unavoidable during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间，下雨是不可避免的。
words.en: If something is unavoidable, it cannot be avoided or prevented.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.ex: He got accepted to Cambridge last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被剑桥大学录取了。
words.en: Cambridge is a city in the United Kingdom, known for its prestigious university, the University of Cambridge.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The stain on the carpet is a mar.
words.ex_cn: 地毯上的污渍是一个污点。
words.en: To mar something means to spoil or damage it.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.tr: n. 转移; 移交，授权; 授权代理
words.ex: The government gave more power to local areas through devolution.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过权力下放将更多权力交给地方。
words.en: The transfer or delegation of power to a lower level, especially by central government to local or regional administration.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: The story includes an illustration of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事包含了一个善良的例证。
words.en: An illustration is a picture or diagram that helps make something clear or attractive.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: He is a famous novelist who writes stories about love.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的作家，写关于爱情的故事。
words.en: A novelist is a person who writes novels.

words.ex: The limitation of the phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的限制是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A limitation is a rule or situation that restricts what you can do or what can happen.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: adj. 出于……意向的；有……企图的
words.ex: He was well-intentioned but his advice was unhelpful.
words.ex_cn: 他是出于好意，但他的建议并不管用。
words.en: Having a specified intention or purpose.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.ex: Measles is a communicable disease.
words.ex_cn: 麻疹是一种会传染的疾病。
words.en: A communicable disease is one that can be passed from one person or animal to another.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: The company advertize its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在电视上为其新手机做广告。
words.en: To advertize means to make something known to the public, especially in order to sell it or promote it.

words.tr: adj. 有深刻了解的；富有洞察力的
words.ex: His insightful comment helped us understand the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他富有洞察力的评论帮助我们理解了这个问题。
words.en: If you describe someone or their remarks as insightful, you mean that they show a very good understanding of people and situations.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: n. 荧光记号笔；轮廓色；着重点
words.ex: He uses a yellow highlighter to mark important text.
words.ex_cn: 他用黄色荧光笔标记重要文字。
words.en: A highlighter is a special pen used to mark important parts of a text by covering them with a bright colour.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.ex: He inadequately prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有充分准备考试。
words.en: In a manner that is not sufficient to meet a requirement or achieve a goal.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.ex: The painter portrays a happy family in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家在画中描绘了一个幸福的家庭。
words.en: To portray someone or something means to show or represent them in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: He answered the question correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: In a manner that is accurate and free from errors.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr: n. 不幸之事；灾祸；恶运
words.ex: He had a little mishap when he dropped his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把咖啡洒了，出了点小差错。
words.en: A mishap is an unlucky accident.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: He gave a philosophical answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个哲学性的回答。
words.en: Relating to or based on philosophy; calm and thoughtful in the face of problems.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: The car moved rapidly down the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车迅速地沿着道路行驶。
words.en: If something happens rapidly, it happens very quickly.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: His entrepreneurship helped start a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他的企业家精神帮助创办了一家小企业。
words.en: Entrepreneurship is the activity of setting up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: He needs to analyse the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他需要仔细分析这些数据。
words.en: To examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.ex_cn: 我明天见你。
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.ex: The accumulation of snow made the road dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 积雪使道路变得危险。
words.en: The process by which something increases in amount or is collected together over time.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.tr: adj. 地质学的；地质上的；
words.ex: The geological layers show the history of the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这些地质层展示了地球的历史。
words.en: Relating to the study of the Earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr:
adv. 在水下；
adj. 水下的；
words.ex: The divers swam underwater to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在水下游泳以探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: Located, occurring, or used beneath the surface of the water.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 会计工作；会计职业；
words.ex: He works in accountancy for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事会计工作。
words.en: Accountancy is the theory or practice of keeping and inspecting financial accounts.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.ex: The visitor took photos of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位参观者拍了博物馆的照片。
words.en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.ex: The educator helps students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这位教育者帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An educator is a person who educates people, especially as a job.

words.ex: He smiled strangely when I asked him the question.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他问题时，他奇怪地笑了。
words.en: In a manner that is unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain.

words.ex: The fire truck connected to the hydrant.
words.ex_cn: 消防车连接到消防栓。
words.en: A hydrant is an upright pipe with a spout, nozzle, or other outlet, usually in the street, for drawing water from a main or service line, especially for fighting fires.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: The two stories intertwine in the final chapter.
words.ex_cn: 这两个故事在最后一章交织在一起。
words.en: If two or more things are intertwined, they are closely connected with each other in many ways.

words.tr:
v. 鞭打；狠打
n. 潜逃
words.ex: The farmer lammed the horse to make it move faster.
words.ex_cn: 农夫鞭打马，让它跑得更快。
words.en: A young sheep, especially one that is still nursing.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.ex: The temperature rose steadily throughout the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天温度稳定地上升。
words.en: If something happens or changes steadily, it happens or changes in a regular way without interruption.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.ex: The teacher will authorise the trip next week.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下周批准这次旅行。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: The two friends reached reconciliation after talking for hours.
words.ex_cn: 两个朋友经过几个小时的交谈后和好了。
words.en: Reconciliation is the process of making two opposite beliefs, ideas, or situations agree.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.tr:
n. 老于世故的人；见多识广的人
v. 使复杂；使变得世故
words.ex: He is a sophisticated who knows how to handle difficult people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个老于世故的人，懂得如何应对难缠的人。
words.en: To make someone or something more knowledgeable, complex, or refined, especially through experience or education.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: The evidence is doubtful.
words.ex_cn: 这些证据是可疑的。
words.en: If you are doubtful about something, you are uncertain about it or not sure that it is true or possible.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He bought a recent book about history.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本最近出版的历史书。
words.en: Having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before; belonging to a past period comparatively close to the present.

words.ex: I recognised my old friend at the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站认出了我的老朋友。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: He reset the password to log in again.
words.ex_cn: 他重置了密码以便再次登录。
words.en: To set again or differently; to adjust or fix in a new or different way.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He receives a small stipend for his internship.
words.ex_cn: 他因实习获得少量薪金。
words.en: A stipend is a sum of money paid regularly as a salary or allowance.

words.tr: adv. 马上；迅速地；准时地；
words.ex: He answered the call promptly.
words.ex_cn: 他马上接了电话。
words.en: If you do something promptly, you do it immediately.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr: adv. 连续地；不断地；连续不断地；
words.ex: The machine works continuously without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器连续工作，不停止。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr:
n. 试听；试唱；试演；听力
v. 试听；试音；试镜；让…试演
words.ex: He went to an audition for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加学校话剧的试听。
words.en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that someone can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: The teacher underscored the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了作业的重要性。
words.en: To emphasize the importance of something or to draw a line underneath a word or phrase.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；乐器的；仪器的；
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对帮助我通过考试很有帮助。
words.en: If someone or something is instrumental in a process, plan, or system, they are one of the most important influences in causing it to happen.

words.tr: adv. 极大地；值得注目地；
words.ex: The new policy significantly improved student performance.
words.ex_cn: 新政策极大地改善了学生的成绩。
words.en: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: Children hunt eggs on Easter morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在复活节早上找鸡蛋。
words.en: Easter is a Christian festival and holiday celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ on the third day after his crucifixion at Calvary as described in the New Testament.

words.ex: The baseline for the experiment was set at 10 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 实验的基线被设定为10度。
words.en: A baseline is a line or standard that is used as a basis for comparison or measurement.

words.ex: She carefully wrote down the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 她仔细地记下了说明。
words.en: In a way that gives a lot of attention to what you are doing so that you do not have an accident, make a mistake, or damage something.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: His estimation of the situation was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对形势的判断是错误的。
words.en: An estimation is a judgment or opinion about the value, quality, or importance of something, or a calculation of the amount, level, or size of something.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
